output_path = Path("/mnt/data/outputs/45581_0_9252ba98/1_45581_output.xlsx")
output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# Load workbook and place the Excel formula in the required cell only.
wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

source_text = ws["B4"].value or ""
insert_pos = 5  # insert a blank after the 5th character
cached_result = source_text[:insert_pos] + " " + source_text[insert_pos:]

ws["D11"] = '=REPLACE(B4,6,0," ")'

# Save first with the formula.
wb.save(output_path)

# Patch the sheet XML to include a cached formula result as well, so data-only readers
# can also see the intended output.
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
    tmpdir = Path(tmpdir)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(output_path, "r") as zin:
        zin.extractall(tmpdir)

    sheet_xml = tmpdir / "xl" / "worksheets" / "sheet1.xml"
    ns = {"main": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"}
    ET.register_namespace("", ns["main"])
    tree = ET.parse(sheet_xml)
    root = tree.getroot()

    cell = root.find(".//main:c[@r='D11']", ns)
    if cell is not None:
        cell.set("t", "str")
        v = cell.find("main:v", ns)
        if v is None:
            v = ET.SubElement(cell, f"{{{ns['main']}}}v")
        v.text = cached_result

    tree.write(sheet_xml, encoding="utf-8", xml_declaration=True)

    with zipfile.ZipFile(output_path, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
        for file in tmpdir.rglob("*"):
            if file.is_file():
                zout.write(file, file.relative_to(tmpdir))
